2608.30609.title: Reading the News: Adapting Large Language Models to Swedish Journalism Through Continued Pre-Training
2608.30609.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly capable in general, but their utility can remain modest in niche or understudied areas. One approach to address this limitation is to specialise existing models through additional training on target-domain corpora. In this work, we investigate such continued pre-training for adapting large language models to Swedish journalism, using a high-quality dataset that we curate from millions of news articles. To evaluate the adaptation efficacy, we also construct a novel domain-specific benchmark that covers six editorial tasks. Through full and parameter-efficient fine-tuning across two model sizes, we find that continued pre-training yields benefits in the target domain, but only when paired with experience replay to mitigate forgetting. We observe consistent enhancements in the models' generation quality and factual knowledge, but not their proficiency in discriminative tasks. Exploring a training-free method to facilitate instruction following, we see further improvements, but exclusively for models trained with low-rank adaptation. Crucially, we demonstrate the importance of targeted evaluation in the adaptation process, as an existing Swedish benchmark largely fails to capture the models' in-domain performance gains.
2608.30609.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型在一般情況下越來越有能力，但在小眾或研究不足的領域，其效用仍然有限。解決這一限制的一種方法是通過在目標領域的語料上進行額外訓練來專門化現有模型。在這項工作中，我們研究了這種持續的預訓練，以將大型語言模型適應於瑞典新聞業，使用我們從數百萬篇新聞文章中整理的高質量數據集。為了評估適應的有效性，我們還構建了一個涵蓋六個編輯任務的新穎領域特定基準。通過對兩種模型大小進行全面和參數高效的微調，我們發現持續的預訓練在目標領域帶來了好處，但僅當與經驗重放結合以減少遺忘時。我們觀察到模型生成質量和事實知識的一致提升，但在區分任務的熟練度上並沒有改進。探索一種無需訓練的方法來促進指令遵循，我們看到進一步的改進，但僅限於使用低秩適應訓練的模型。關鍵是，我們展示了在適應過程中針對性評估的重要性，因為現有的瑞典基準在很大程度上未能捕捉模型在內部領域的性能提升。
